summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The USCF Dividend Income Fund (UDI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that primarily invests in US exchange-traded, dividend-paying companies that meet the funds financial and ESG criteria. UDI was launched on Jun 8, 2022 and is issued by Marygold.

holdings.infoBox: UDI is an equity ETF with a total of 44 individual holdings. The top holdings are Johnson & Johnson stock at 3.81%, East West Bancorp at 3.44%, AbbVie at 3.41%, Medtronic at 3.34%, and Lamar Advertising Company at 3.09%.
